splashScreens.1: Satellite models appear bigger than they really are. Everything else is to scale.
splashScreens.2: The settings menu located in the bottom toolbar contains many options to customize your experience.
splashScreens.3: Many of the menus have additional settings that can be accessed by clicking the gear icon.
splashScreens.4: Add satellites to the watchlist to get notifications when they are overhead of the current sensor.
splashScreens.5: Right click on the globe to open the context menu with more options.
splashScreens.6: You can search for satellites by name or NORAD ID in the search bar at the top right.
splashScreens.7: A new launch nominal can be created by selecting a satellite and clicking the 'New Launch' button in the bottom menu.
splashScreens.8: Set an object as Secondary to see its relative distance with primary object.
